title: [Bug]: the subscription doesnt work properly when the subscription link points to a page
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Ubuntu 24.04.1 - V2RayN V7.10.5 X64 

### 预期情况

Like in the android version, when you copy the subscription link and click update subscriptions, all servers are loaded properly

### 实际情况

Some subscription links actually point to an actual page, where it hosts different severs, these kinds of URLS/Links dont work in the Linux version. They however, work just fine in the android version though and all servers gets loaded properly.
Below is one of such links as you can see:  
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9ebdf6fd-7865-4e2a-8c25-5db8806cf443)

Currently, if I paste the link and do a Update Subscriptions without a proxy, none of the fields except remarks get populated properly, and instead of the actual url, it contains json filenames as follows:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c376eced-9610-4289-b498-c7936ba9796d)

which wont work, and I need to manually add each server link by hand. 

It would be great if these links start working in the Linux version as well, makes life much easier. 
Thanks a lot in advance

### 复现方法

simply copy the subscription link, copy from clipboard from Servers Menu (Ctrl+V), followed by Update Subscriptions without proxy.

title: [Bug]: HTTP代理不能使用 h2 协议
body:
### 操作系统和版本

7.10.5

### 预期情况

HTTP 代理中使用 h2 协议

### 实际情况

当指定 Alpn 以 h2 来接连服务器，未能正确的使用标准的 h2 协议，导致支持 h2 协议的 HTTP 代理服务器报错。  
换 ZeroOmega 或其他 HTTP 代理客户端都能正确走 h2 协议。
疑似 v2rayN 使用了 h2 的握手后，后续仍然使用 h1 来连接导致服务器失败（猜测,未证实）

### 复现方法

HTTP代理服务器是支持 h2 的，当 v2rayN 客户端设置 启用传输层安全(TLS) ，ALPN 为 h2 或 h2,http/1.1 时

title: [Bug]: v2rayN doesn't add its tray icon back to waybar's tray after the bar restart; runs in background, but can't be opened again (launches new instance instead)
body:
### 操作系统和版本 v2rayN 7.10.5; on Arch Linux latest with linux-lts 6.12.21; hyprland 0.48.1 (wayland compositor); waybar 0.12.0 (bar & tray) ### 预期情况 v2rayN tray icon appears at waybar's tray module after waybar restart ### 实际情况 **Context:** To reload its configuration fully, [Waybar](https://github.com/Alexays/Waybar) needs to be restarted. There is also a way to reload just .css styles, but both have this issue. It's relevant when e.g. switching your system from light mode to dark mode; or applying new configuration to waybar. **What happens:** When waybar is started before v2rayN - tray icon appears as it should, and functions normally. But after waybar's restart, every single tray icon that was there before the restart reappears as it should, _except v2rayN._ v2rayN icon doesn't appear. It seems that once tray is lost, v2rayN considers it to be permanent, and doesn't try to look for a new tray to add v2rayN icon to it. ### 复现方法 To reproduce: 1. launch waybar with `waybar --config ./waybar-minimal-tray.jsonc --style ./waybar-minimal-style.css`, where
waybar-minimal-tray.jsonc

```jsonc { "layer": "overlay", "position": "bottom", // Waybar position (top|bottom|left|right) "exclusive": false, // don't reserve space for bar, open over existing windows "height": 44, // "width": 500, "modules-right": ["tray"], "tray": { // "icon-size": 21, "spacing": 10 } } ```

waybar-minimal-style.css

```css @define-color background #f8e1e1; @define-color foreground rgba(27, 22, 22, 0.85); * { border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: Monospace; font-size: 14px; } window#waybar { background: transparent; } #tray { margin-bottom: 4px; margin-top: 4px; padding-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px; transition: none; color: @foreground; background: @background; border-radius: 26px; } ```

it should appear at the bottom right of your screen. ![01-04-2025-19_51_50](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0bbb938b-811a-4d86-9219-50a3198cde15) 2. launch v2rayN ![01-04-2025-19_57_47](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/422b7c07-5c2f-4d4c-9bda-ca28d6c4f23c) 3. restart waybar Ctrl-C the running `waybar ... ` command then launch waybar again ![01-04-2025-20_15_13](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/709a1968-976a-4f91-b7aa-34e9b70f6090) Notice no v2rayN icon, but all other are present. 4. But v2rayN is actually still running in background! Htop: ![01-04-2025-20_18_07](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1d4ea5a5-5e1c-4a02-bf70-74fcae293cd9) (can also be checked with ```bash ~ ❯ lsof -i :10808 COMMAND PID USER FD TYPE DEVICE SIZE/OFF NODE NAME xray 142166 witch 4u IPv4 1009098 0t0 TCP localhost:10808 (LISTEN) xray 142166 witch 7u IPv4 1009100 0t0 UDP localhost:10808 ~ ❯ pgrep -a 'v2rayN|xray' 142070 /usr/lib/v2rayN/v2rayN 142166 /home/witch/.local/share/v2rayN/bin/xray/xray run -c config.json ``` 5. Try to open v2rayN again - the icon appears... However, it's just another instance of v2rayN ![01-04-2025-20_32_11](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/13f5cd24-1709-40ea-9d22-81a3c8c8dcc9) ```bash ~ ❯ pgrep -a 'v2rayN|xray' 142070 /usr/lib/v2rayN/v2rayN 142166 /home/witch/.local/share/v2rayN/bin/xray/xray run -c config.json 184168 /usr/lib/v2rayN/v2rayN 184268 /home/witch/.local/share/v2rayN/bin/xray/xray run -c config.json ~ ❯ lsof -i :10808 COMMAND PID USER FD TYPE DEVICE SIZE/OFF NODE NAME xray 142166 witch 4u IPv4 1009098 0t0 TCP localhost:10808 (LISTEN) xray 142166 witch 7u IPv4 1009100 0t0 UDP localhost:10808 xray 142166 witch 13u IPv4 1293226 0t0 TCP localhost:10808->localhost:47408 (ESTABLISHED) v2rayN 184168 witch 254u IPv6 1298659 0t0 TCP localhost:47408->localhost:10808 (ESTABLISHED) xray 184268 witch 4u IPv4 1293702 0t0 TCP localhost:10808 (LISTEN) xray 184268 witch 7u IPv4 1293704 0t0 UDP localhost:10808 ``` Somehow 2 `xray`s seems to bind _one_ 10808 port. It shouldn't be possible, so something is up. The proxy continues to work in my apps. Anyway, instead of reopening closed (hidden) and still running in background v2rayN that now lacks tray icon, it opens _another_ v2rayN. ### It should instead: 1. open the already running instance of v2rayN 2. add its tray icon back to the bar when it will become available again ### 日志信息 [2025-04-01.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19555736/2025-04-01.txt) All of the errors seems to be related to `proxy_set_linux_sh.sh none` failing because I use hyprland and not gnome or kde. It's irrelevant because I don't need v2rayN to set global system proxy, I just use `localhost:10808` where needed. The end of the log has no errors because I switched it to "do not change proxy" mode. The overall behavior is the same. Also, when clicking on v2rayN tray icon to open v2rayN (which works fine _when the icon is there_), waybar logs: ```log (waybar:293932): LIBDBUSMENU-GTK-WARNING **: 22:01:19.712: The child-display variable is set to '(null)' but there's a menu, odd? ``` (it doesn't do that for other icons) ### 额外信息 I use v2rayN with regional preset Russia (proxy everything except internal sites). I have tray and hide to tray enabled in v2rayN settings. I've used "clear system proxy" (as it was default) and TUN disabled for the screenshots. But even with "do not change system proxy", the behavior is the same. Since I use `localhost:10808` socks5 proxy in the apps I need to proxy, like the browser, `proxy_set_linux_sh.sh` is irrelevant for me. If v2rayN is launched before the waybar, it can add its icon to waybar's tray after waybar is launched. **So it clearly can add its icon to tray that just appeared**. Also, AvaloniaUI doesn't support wayland, so the app runs via xwayland. But I don't see why that should be the cause of the issue, because it clearly can add its icon to tray, just not after it already did and the existing tray disappeared, because the bar was restarted, and the new tray was created. I searched for similar issues in English, but found none describing my problem. I don't speak Chinese, so searching using google translate didn't amount to anything useful too. There are some issues where tray doesn't work _at all_, but that's clearly not the case for me. It works. It just doesn't try to re-add itself if tray temporarily disappears. ### 我确认已更新至最新版本 - [X] 是 ### 我确认已查询历史issues - [X] 是

title: [Bug]: TUN mode: Ping broken
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 11

### 预期情况

ping / tracert should not resolve unavailable IP adresses when TUN mode is on

### 实际情况

When TUN mode is on, regardless of core type used (xray / sing-box), running ping to any random IP address (for example 1.2.3.4) always responds with <1 ms time.
'tracert' command acts the same, resolving any IP address and printing a single jump to destination (as if localhost is 1.2.3.4).

Exisitng IP adresses are resolved in tracert in a single jump too (and they should not be reached in 1 jump).

### 复现方法

Run v2rayN
Select a server and make it active
Turn "TUN mode" toggler on
Open cmd.exe
Run ping 1.2.3.4 (or any random IP)

title: [Bug]: 没有关闭V2rayN关机或重启后，系统代理不起作用，要重置电脑网络协议配置才能恢复
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows IoT LTSC 2021      V2rayN v7.10.5

### 预期情况

即使不关闭V2rayN应用，重启或关机电脑后应用系统代理仍能正常使用。

### 实际情况

我使用SwitchyOmega配合V2rayN使用，平时不开系统代理，只是让应用开机自启动，但有时重启电脑时会因为应用退出错误导致电脑网络配置出错，致使电脑重新开启后V2rayN系统代理不能正常使用，需要以管理员权限在cmd运行“netsh winsock reset”重置网络协议配置再重启电脑才能恢复正常系统代理。

### 复现方法

将V2rayN设置为开机自启动，电脑重启时保持开启V2rayN（不论是否开启系统代理都行），电脑重新开启后应用系统代理无法使用，若没有出现可以多重复几次这个过程

title: Improve Accessibility for "More Options" Button in MainWindow.xaml
body:
Summary
The "More Options" button in the toolbar of MainWindow.xaml, implemented using a PopupBox control from MaterialDesignInXaml, lacks an accessibility label for screen readers like NVDA. The internal ToggleButton (named PART_Toggle in the PopupBox template) does not have an AutomationProperties.Name set, causing NVDA to fail to announce a meaningful label when the button is focused. This makes the application less accessible for visually impaired users.
Steps to Reproduce
1. Run the v2rayN application.
2. Navigate to the toolbar using the Tab or Alt keys to focus on the "More Options" button (the PopupBox located after the "Close" menu item).
3. Use a screen reader like NVDA to listen to the announced label.
Current Behavior
• NVDA does not announce a meaningful label for the "More Options" button because the internal ToggleButton (PART_Toggle) in the PopupBox template lacks an AutomationProperties.Name.
• This results in a poor accessibility experience for visually impaired users, as they cannot identify the button's purpose.
Expected Behavior
• When focusing on the "More Options" button using Tab or Alt keys, NVDA should announce "More Options toggle not pressed" (or the localized equivalent from ResUI.pbTheme).
• The button should remain fully functional, opening/closing the popup as it currently does.
Relevant Code
The issue is with the following PopupBox in MainWindow.xaml:
xaml
Collapse
Wrap
Copy
<materialDesign:PopupBox
    Padding="-2"
    HorizontalAlignment="Right"
    StaysOpen="True"
    Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignToolForegroundPopupBox}">
    <ContentControl x:Name="pbTheme" />
</materialDesign:PopupBox>
The PopupBox uses the MaterialDesignToolForegroundPopupBox style, which includes a ToggleButton named PART_Toggle in its template. This ToggleButton does not have an AutomationProperties.Name set, causing the accessibility issue.

title: 【安全】Linux 版本使用 `CAP_NET_ADMIN` 获取网络权限
body:
## 问题描述

当前（测试版本：`7.10.5`），为了开启 TUN 模式，v2rayN 仍然使用保存并加密 `sudo` 密码的方式。但是这种方法不仅导致密码被**可解密**地（不同于 Linux 内核的哈希方法）保存在本地，而且默认配置文件是普通用户可读的；事实上，整个 `/opt/v2rayn` 都是如此。

这不是 Linux 权限系统的常规做法，是否被看做一个**潜在安全风险**？

## 替代方法

考虑到 `libcap2` 包及其提供的 `setcap` 工具在大多数发行版中都是默认包含的，我认为使用 [`CAP_NET_ADMIN`](https://man.archlinux.org/man/capabilities.7#CAP_NET_ADMIN) 权限单独授权 sing-box 内核执行操作，更符合 Linux 权限系统的要求和推荐做法，例如：

```bash
sudo setcap cap_net_admin=+ep $SING_BOX_LOCATION
```

当然，这会与 SE Linux 和 AppArmor 这类拓展权限系统产生冲突，但是在桌面端启用这些功能似乎不太常见。

## 备注

我不熟悉 C# 和 v2rayN 的代码，可能无法 PR，不过这似乎不难实现。

body:
手动更新订阅可以选择”不通过代理“，可否在自动更新订阅的设置中添加代理模式的选择？
【仅不使用代理/仅使用代理/优先不使用代理/优先使用代理】
> https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/issues/5692#issuecomment-2352411621

因为我的订阅下载是基于IP白名单，如果使用了代理的IP，则不在IP白名单，更新会失败（会将一个普通网页下载保存为类似58d95002-263e-4c88-9111-d2100eb20735.yaml文件并展示在节点列表中）。

或者说判断，如果一个链接，虽然能访问，但解析不成订阅，则判断更新失败，再尝试不通过代理再次更新，不要生成类似58d95002-263e-4c88-9111-d2100eb20735.yaml的文件。

title: [Bug]: Hy2 启用 Tun 后，本地端口的代理无法连通网络
body:
### 操作系统和版本

`Windows 11 23H2`, `v2rayN - V7.11.3 - X64 - 以管理员身份运行`

### 预期情况

Hy2 启用 Tun 后，本地端口的代理可以连通网络

### 实际情况

Hy2 启用 Tun 后，本地端口的代理无法连通网络，但不通过本地 s5/http，则正常连通

### 复现方法

### 使用本地端口的代理无网络
1. 选中 hy2 节点并回车
2. 启用 Tun
3. 浏览器设置代理的插件中填写本地代理（http/socks）
4. 打开任一网址，均无法联通网络

### 不使用本地端口的代理，正常有网
1. 选中 hy2 节点并回车
2. 启用 Tun
3. 打开任一网址，均有网络

title: [Bug]: Routing Rules Not Saved or Applied When Using Multi-configurations
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 10 / Windows 11, v2rayN-windows-64 v7.11.3

### 预期情况

Routing rules domains added via the GUI not properly formatted and applied. 

### 实际情况

When adding multiple domains in the GUI (e.g., pasting a list of domains), the resulting configuration is incorrectly formatted in the config.json file. The domains are concatenated with newline characters (\n), which makes the routing rules invalid.

For example, when multiple domains are pasted, the resulting config file looks like this:

```
{
  "type": "field",
  "network": "tcp,udp",
  "outboundTag": "direct",
  "domain": [
    "example.com\ndomain2.com\ndomain3.com\n"
  ]
}
```


### 复现方法

Open V2RayN.

Add routing rules through the GUI, pasting multiple domains lines at once.

Save and apply.

See misleading message "Operation successful"

Check the config.json file in the binConfigs folder — the domains will be concatenated with \n characters and will not work.

title: [Bug]: 使用SS节点  实际连接网页延迟异常高
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Win11 23H2 22631.5335

### 预期情况

该节点正常情况下使用延迟应该很低 应用内测试工具一般低于100 

### 实际情况

使用特定配置时 应用内的测试延迟工具显示的依然是低延迟
但是打开网页或者使用自制工具测的  延迟异常高  

### 复现方法

下载最新版v2rayN  (更新core,Geofile或不更新皆可复现) 使用默认配置    
(不确定是从哪一版开始有的这个bug, 自用很长时间使用的都是DoH的DNS, 最近重新下载才发现的问题)
更改域名解析策略设为IP on Demand或者IP if NonMatch   
使用Shadowsocks协议的节点
打开网页延迟非常高
用自制测试网页延迟的工具测得  
在使用的规则集中每用到一个含有"IP或IP CIDR"内容的项目 延迟就增加4000ms



### 额外信息

目前可解决这个问题的配置(任意一种都可)
1. 解析策略使用AsIs
2. 在使用的规则集中关闭用到"IP或IP CIDR"的项目(每关闭一个项目 延迟就会降低一点)
3. 把DNS设置中的DNS用DoH版代替默认udp的 比如 8.8.8.8换为https://dns.google/dns-query 223.5.5.5换为https://223.5.5.5/dns-query 1.1.1.1换为https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
4. 使用非Shadowsocks协议的节点
5. Shadowsocks协议使用sing_box的core

测试使用旧版本的v2rayN 如7.4.2 + 新版的xray-core  25.4.30 就没有问题

### 相关问题

希望在点击更新订阅时获取并展示该订阅“剩余流量”、”到期日期“等信息。

### 描述你希望的解决方案

有些订阅自带一些节点,节点名称就是剩余流量，到期日期等信息，但是有些订阅没有这种个节点。

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a75a5bbd-26ae-4af9-afaf-71854693781e)

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

对于没有含有带信息的节点的订阅, 同一个订阅链接IOS的Shadowrocket就可以显示类似截图中这样的信息，不知道是怎么获取到

的，v2rayN里就没有。
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8806ef6c-8df2-4f6d-9839-37a5a773742d)



[https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/issues/3743#issue-1679933331](url) 听说clashN有这个功能 ，不知道是不是clash订阅的特性。

[https://github.com/2dust/clashN/issues/358#issue-2330302900](url) 看到大佬有合并clashN和v2rayN的Todo，但是还没提上日

程，不知道能不能率先在v2rayN上找个固定的位置展示这种信息，免去总去机场dashboard查看的麻烦，谢谢！

title: [Feature request]: FakeHTTP support
body:
### 相关问题

有时候被运营商限速到1Mbps，使用fakeHttp可以避免这种情况

### 描述你希望的解决方案

支持fakeHttp,解除运营商限速

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

https://github.com/MikeWang000000/FakeHTTP 
FakeHTTP 只插入，不转发。             
SYN -- SYN-ACK -- ACK -*- 数据 1 -- 数据 2 ...  
FakeHTTP 在 [ ACK -*- 数据 1 ] 之间，直接对外发送含有 HTTP 特征的 TCP 报文，不涉及任何转发。 
FakeHTTP 检查入站的第一个 ACK 或者 SYN-ACK ，后续数据包打上 fwmark 不再检查。
TTL 值默认为 3 ，可以通过 -t <ttl> 调整。要让这个 HTTP 数据包刚好通过限速检查，但不被目标服务器收到。
将 HTTP 特征在 [数据 1] 前发送出去。http明文报文伪装成运营商的白名单测速网站，于是该连接将不被限速模板限制到1Mbps

author: yuzyf

title: [Feature request]: Add option to disable QR code scanning to prevent conflicts with DRM-protected players like Spot Player
body:
### 相关问题

Spot Player 是一个带有强 DRM 保护的视频播放器。当 v2rayN 启用了二维码扫描功能时，Spot Player 会将其误判为屏幕录制软件，从而阻止视频播放。请增加一个选项，允许用户关闭二维码扫描功能，以解决此冲突。

### 描述你希望的解决方案

请增加一个可选项，允许用户关闭或暂停二维码扫描功能。这样用户在使用 Spot Player 或类似 DRM 保护播放器时，可以避免因二维码扫描被误判为录屏软件而导致播放被阻止，从而实现两者兼容共存。

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

除了增加关闭二维码扫描的选项外，目前没有有效的解决方法可以避免 v2rayN 与 Spot Player 的冲突。禁用二维码扫描是最直接且用户友好的方案。

title: [Bug]: 在 GUI 的路由里添加仅 network: "tcp,udp" 的规则无法生效
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 10 以及 v2rayN 7.12.5

### 预期情况

config.json 与 GUI 保持一致，存在仅包含 network: "tcp,udp" 和 outbound: "direct" 的规则。

### 实际情况

在 GUI 里设置一个仅 network: "tcp,udp" 和 outbound: "direct"、不包含任何其他选项的规则。但实际上该规则实际并不会出现在 config.json 里。

在以前的 v2rayN 版本里不能保存这种仅设置了 network 的规则，只能使用 port: "0-65535" 做为兜底规则。新版本 v2rayN 里可以保存这种仅 network 的规则，却未生成对应的规则。

### 复现方法

1、在 GUI 的路由里添加如下图所示的兜底规则，保存并应用：
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/885ee776-054c-4a12-90c2-768e297e4a60)

2、打开 v2rayN 目录下的 config.json 文件，查看 outbounds 部分。按理说应该出现下面这种规则，但实际并没有出现：
```
            {
                "type": "field",
                "network": "tcp,udp",
                "outboundTag": "direct"
            }
```

3、再次编辑 GUI，规则里额外添加 IP: "0.0.0.0/0"，保存并应用。

4、重新打开 v2rayN 目录下的 config.json 文件，查看 outbounds 部分，可见正常产生如下规则：
```
      {
        "type": "field",
        "network": "tcp,udp",
        "outboundTag": "direct",
        "ip": [
          "0.0.0.0/0"
        ]
      }
```

title: [Bug]: don't understand why routing rule "geosite:google-deepmind" fails
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 11 Home Build 10.26.0.100

### 预期情况

v2rayN applies a rule to a set of domains from "dcl"

### 实际情况

v2rayN "ignores" record for "geosite:google-deepmind". however, changing it to list of all the domains from [dls](https://github.com/v2fly/domain-list-community/blob/master/data/google-deepmind) helps.

---

### 复现方法

If i set this rule
```json
[
  {
    "outboundTag": "proxy",
    "domain": [
      "geosite:google-deepmind"
    ],
    "enabled": true,
    "remarks": "\u041A\u0430\u0441\u0442\u043E\u043C gemini (this is utf8 cyrrilic)"
  }
]
```
one of domains particularly `
https://alkalimakersuite-pa.clients6.google.com/$rpc/google.internal.alkali.applications.makersuite.v1.MakerSuiteService/GenerateAccessToken` fails although `alkalimakersuite-pa.clients6.google.com` is in [domain list community](https://github.com/v2fly/domain-list-community/blob/master/data/google-deepmind)

if i manually change "geosite:google-deepmind" to the contents of [dlc google-deepmind contents](https://github.com/v2fly/domain-list-community/blob/master/data/google-deepmind) like so
```
deepmind.com,
deepmind.google,
geller-pa.googleapis.com,
generativelanguage.googleapis.com,
proactivebackend-pa.googleapis.com,
full:ai.google.dev,
full:alkalicore-pa.clients6.google.com,

bard.google.com,
gemini.google,
gemini.google.com,
notebooklm.google,
notebooklm.google.com,
jules.google,
jules.google.com
```
the rule for using proxy works properly.


i use rules preset for russia. So geosite:google-deepmind loads from [russia-v2ray-rules-dat](https://github.com/runetfreedom/russia-v2ray-rules-dat) and then from [dlc](https://github.com/v2fly/domain-list-community/blob/master/data/google-deepmind). title: [Feature request]: 路由规则不会随着V2rayN版本更新而更新，每个版本的路由规则似乎不完全一致，各个版本的路由规则不统一
body:
### 相关问题

使用不同的V2rayN版本，对比后发现默认的路由规则不完全一致，以默认的绕过大陆为例子，有的版本的规则内是8个条目，有的是9个条目，我用的去年版本的是10个条目（多出一条最后规则所有端口走proxy，但是新版本的默认路由规则没有这个条目）
这样就会出现一个问题，就是软件是去年版本的，使用过程中更新最新版，但是路由规则没有更新，会导致：

**最新的软件使用旧版本的路由规则。**

大概是去年的版本的路由规则，10条：

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/431c6b0e-8839-4ad4-a853-05c094e3140b)

最新的7.12.5版本的路由规则，8条：

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7dbe73c8-5d3a-4223-bb8c-d41231af25b4)

2025.04版本的路由规则，9条：
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cc9b534f-458d-41a2-9219-c46097a705ab)



### 描述你希望的解决方案

希望路由规则优化变动后，随着软件版本的更新一同更新，做到软件更新后使用最新的优化后的路由规则。

body:
### 相关问题

做外贸希望同时用多个浏览器打开同一个站点，但是对应不同国家，所以我有多个国家的节点，但问题是现在每次只能连接一个节点，如果能同时开多个节点，每个节点端口不同（做成可以自定义），这样我就可以在浏览器中用Proxy SwitchyOmega 之类的插件把当前浏览器代理到对应节点的端口中

### 描述你希望的解决方案

把v2rayN做成可同时开启多个节点，其实就是core运行多个实例，只不过每个实例对应的配置文件不一样（出站节点不一样），并且有一个节点为主节点，自动配置系统代理 就配置这个主节点对应的端口，其它节点就要我们用浏览器或对应的app自动去填代理端口

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

V2rayN启动多次，但我认为这样有点复杂了，没啥必要，还是在一个V2rayN里运行多个xray进程就行

title: [Bug]: v2rayN fails to connect after reboot on Windows 11 24H2 (only works via TUN, then stops working entirely)
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 11 Pro 24H2 (Build 26100.4349), v2rayN 7.12.7 (SelfContained). Tested with both sing-box and xray cores, latest versions

### 预期情况

Signs of ability to work in any way

### 实际情况

After a fresh install of v2rayN everything works fine.
After a reboot or after a few days — v2rayN completely stops working outside of local network.
No external connectivity. Only TUN mode works temporarily. Eventually, even that fails.

When running in PAC or Set System Proxy mode with (and without) the TUN mode:
- HttpClient fails with: net_io_readfailure
- System.Net.Sockets.SocketException: connection was forcibly closed by remote host
- Outbound traffic is not blocked by firewall, but doesn’t leave the machine
- All connections to 127.0.0.1:10808 report refused, even though port is open and listening

What was tested:

- DNS: works (resolves fine)
- Route table: flushed via route -f
- Winsock: reset via netsh winsock reset
- Full removal of all network devices and drivers (WinTUN, WinDivert, VPN interfaces)
- Verified config works on Linux and Android, in the same LAN and with the same profile

Related issues:

#7455 — probably similar problem: v2rayN works but eventually stops working.

### 复现方法

1. Install v2rayN + auto-generated and/or edited working profiles
2. Use PAC or Set System Proxy
3. Confirm proxy works normally
4. Actually use the proxy. Change profiles, play with rules, update cores, switch the TUN mode multiple times, reboot the system a few more times,doomscroll the resources that are used through the proxy. Just the usual user behavior. I suspect this error is related to Windows, so I guess there's nothing you can actually do to trigger the bug in v2rayN by itself. It only occur naturally and randomly, after some time 
5. At some point v2rayN is unable to proxy traffic
6. Use TUN mode. It works for a while, then breaks too. In my case just in a few hours

### 日志信息

Here's ALL of my logs from v2rayN. Was using nekobox previously, moved to nekoray just recently, on june 17th.

Encountered issue around 2025-06-19 ~07:00. Was actively using the proxy the whole night, but only have logs from 07:48

title: [Bug]: v2rayn运行后连不上xray
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Ubuntu 24.04.1安装xray，win10上运行7.12.5版本的v2rayn

### 预期情况

 v2ray运行后应该连上xray

### 实际情况

在linux上运行wget -N --no-check-certificate -q -O install.sh "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wulabing/Xray_onekey/main/install.sh" && chmod +x install.sh && bash install.sh，选择1，第一种安装 Xray (VLESS + TCP + XTLS / TLS + Nginx)，请输入你的域名信息(eg: www.wulabing.com):输入自己的域名，该域名由cloudflare解析。xray端口选择输入443， 是否配置伪装网页？[Y/N] ，输入Y, 最后安装完，安装完后得到 URL 链接 (VLESS + TCP + XTLS) 
[OK]  vless://xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.com 
然后复制上面的URL 链接，
一切正常运行nginx和xray。这里看到安装的是Xray 25.6.8，然后我的电脑是win10，从https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/releases/download/7.12.5/v2rayN-windows-64-SelfContained.zip下载v2rayN-windows-64-SelfContained，解压后以管理员身份运行，然后点击配置文件，选择从剪切板导入分享链接，系统代理选择自动配置系统代理，路由选择v3--绕过大陆，运行，然后发现v2rayn连接不上xray。

### 复现方法

在linux上运行wget -N --no-check-certificate -q -O install.sh "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wulabing/Xray_onekey/main/install.sh" && chmod +x install.sh && bash install.sh，选择1，第一种安装 Xray (VLESS + TCP + XTLS / TLS + Nginx)，请输入你的域名信息(eg: www.wulabing.com):输入自己的域名，该域名由cloudflare解析。xray端口选择输入443， 是否配置伪装网页？[Y/N] ，输入Y, 最后安装完，安装完后得到 URL 链接 (VLESS + TCP + XTLS) 
[OK]  vless://xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.com 
然后复制上面的URL 链接，
一切正常运行nginx和xray。这里看到安装的是Xray 25.6.8，然后我的电脑是win10，下载最新的v2rayN-windows-64-SelfContained，解压后以管理员身份运行，然后点击配置文件，选择从剪切板导入分享链接，系统代理选择自动配置系统代理，路由选择v3--绕过大陆，运行，然后发现v2rayn连接不上xray。

title: [Bug]: help clash type is not work
body:
### 操作系统和版本

win11 + v7.12.7 

### 预期情况

正常使用clash类型订阅

### 实际情况

求助：
其它地方正常使用的clash订阅， （clash软件中正常使用的，想使用这个软件来统一，遇到问题）

- 在订阅中设置clash类型，能正常显示，clash中显示速度是正常的。但是v2ray显示连接为-1。
- 在订阅中设置转为v2ray类型，也能正常显示一条一条连接，但每条连接测试速度都是-1。


![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d2bcfb32-7afa-4b39-9e83-100283dc09d4)



### 复现方法

不知道是否有其它使用都有类似情况。这边一直是这个情况。

title: [Bug]: [Accessibility] NVDA does not read selected items in ListBox and DataGrid
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 10 x64 - Version 10.0.19045

### 预期情况

When using a screen reader like NVDA:  - The ListBox should announce the selected item (e.g., "import_sub") when it gains focus - The DataGrid should announce the currently selected row, such as the profile name (from the Remarks field), when navigating with arrow keys

### 实际情况

### Accessibility issue summary

When using NVDA (screen reader), there are two areas in the app where selected items are not announced correctly:

#### 1. ListBox (e.g., profile group selector)
- The ListBox showing subscription groups (e.g., "import_sub") does not announce selected items
- NVDA only reads the object type (e.g., "ListBox item") instead of the content (e.g., the group name)

#### 2. DataGrid (profile list)
- Navigating the DataGrid rows using arrow keys does not announce the selected server profile
- Instead, NVDA reads the class name (e.g., `ServiceLib.Models.ProfileItemModel`) or says "data item"

---

### Expected behavior

- NVDA should announce the actual content (like `Remarks`) for each item in the ListBox
- In the DataGrid, NVDA should announce the selected row's key content (e.g., server name from `Remarks`)

---

### Proposed solution

I've submitted a Pull Request to address these two issues by setting `AutomationProperties.Name`:

- In the **ListBox**, it's added via the global `ItemContainerStyle` (`MyChipListBoxItem`)
- In the **DataGrid**, it's applied to `DataGridRow` using a global style in `App.xaml`

🔗 **PR**: https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/pull/7475

---

### Why this matters

These fixes make the app usable for blind or visually impaired users relying on screen readers like NVDA.  
The changes do **not** affect visual UI or functional logic — only accessibility behavior is improved.

I'm happy to revise or adapt if needed.

Thanks for your time and consideration!


### 复现方法

1. Launch the app with NVDA running
2. Use Tab to focus on the subscription group ListBox (e.g., contains "import_sub", "All")
3. Press arrow keys to move between items
   - NVDA does not read the selected item text

4. Then use Tab to reach the main profile DataGrid
5. Use Up/Down arrow keys to navigate between rows
   - NVDA announces only "data item" or class name, not profile name (Remarks)


### 日志信息

N/A – this issue does not produce any errors in the log.
It affects screen reader behavior only.

title: [Bug]: sing-box 连接 hysterial2 协议代理有时莫名异常、无法连接，建议用原生 hysterial2 二进制文件替换
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Win11 24H2 / v2rayN V7.12.7

### 预期情况

sing-box 与 hysterial2 协议目前仍存在兼容性问题

### 实际情况

sing-box 与 hysterial2 协议目前仍存在兼容性问题

### 复现方法

【复现方法】

1. 首先用官方 hysterial2 二进制文件连接远程 hysterial2 代理，本地监听端口为1099，为 socks5 的入口。
2. 将这个 127.0.0.1:1099 的代理添进 v2rayN 中，然后分别测试切换用 Xray 内核和 sing-box 内核负责这个代理，此时 v2rayN 的监听端口是 10808。
3. 在 xshell 中设置通过 socks5://127.0.0.1:10808 的代理连接远程 ssh 主机，当使用 Xray 负责管理【127.0.0.1:1099】的这个代理时正常，但当 sing-box 负责时就会导致无法连接。

总结：这个问题也解释了 v2rayN 使用sing-box 连接 hysterial2 代理时，时不时会无法连接，体验很差，而且速度无法达到最大的问题。在连接同样 hysterial2 代理的情况下，使用 sing-box 测速只有 96 Mbps，官方原生的二进制文件可以达到 140 Mbps（达到当前网路的宽带下载的上限，即也是 140Mbps ）。

title: [Bug]: Path not applied for TCP protocol in VLESS configuration
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Operating System: Windows 10 Pro Version: 22H2 (Build 19045.5965) v2rayN Version: 7.12.7 Xray Core Version: 25.6.8

### 预期情况

When configuring a VLESS server with the TCP protocol, the "Path" field should be displayed in the UI and included in the generated configuration file (e.g., in streamSettings.path for TCP). Similar to how Path is handled for ws or gRPC protocols, it should be available and applied correctly for TCP.

### 实际情况

When selecting the TCP protocol for a VLESS configuration, the "Path" field is not displayed in the UI, and the entered Path value is not included in the generated configuration file. This issue seems to stem from the SetTips function, which does not set a tooltip or enable the Path field for TCP, unlike ws or gRPC protocols.

The issue appears to be related to the SetTips function in AddServerWindow.xaml.cs. In the function, the Path field (txtPath) is only enabled with tooltips for ws, httpupgrade, xhttp, h2, and gRPC protocols. For TCP, the tipPath.Text is set to an empty string, and the Path field is not displayed or applied in the configuration. Here is the relevant code snippet:

```csharp
case nameof(ETransport.tcp):
    tipRequestHost.Text = ResUI.TransportRequestHostTip1;
    tipHeaderType.Text = ResUI.TransportHeaderTypeTip1;
    break;

### 复现方法

Steps to Reproduce:

1.Launch v2rayN and click on "Import" to add a new server configuration using a VLESS link.
2.Paste a VLESS configuration link that includes TCP as the transport protocol and a specified "path" parameter (e.g., vless://[ID]@[Address]:[Port]?type=tcp&path=/yourpath).
3.Confirm the import and open the server configuration in the " Server" window to verify the settings.
4.Check the "Network" dropdown (cmbNetwork) and confirm it is set to "tcp".
5.Observe that the "Path" field (txtPath) is either not visible or not populated with the path value from the link.
6.Save the configuration and export it to a JSON file.
7.Check the generated JSON config file and note that the "path" field is missing in the "streamSettings" section for TCP.

title: [Feature request]: Support HWID transmission when importing subscriptions
body:
### 相关问题

When I want to import or update a subscription, I need the server to recognize the client’s HWID in order to perform authorization. Currently, v2rayN does not include any HWID in the subscription request, so the backend cannot distinguish devices.

### 描述你希望的解决方案

When updating or importing a subscription, v2rayN should automatically attach the client's HWID:  Option 1: Add a custom HTTP header (e.g., x-hwid: <hwid>)  Option 2: Append a query parameter to the subscription URL (e.g., ?hwid=<hwid>)  To respect user privacy, a toggle could be added in Settings → Subscriptions to enable or disable HWID transmission.  The existing logic for HWID generation can be reused.

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

- Manually adding the HWID to the subscription URL every time, but this is inconvenient and error-prone. - Adding a manual field in settings to input the HWID, but this requires users to find it and input it themselves.

title: What I'm trying to do:
body:
What I'm trying to do:
`Browser → Xray (127.0.0.1:10808)  
       → Upstream HTTP/SOCKS proxy (127.0.0.1:10810, Psiphon 3)  
       → VMess / VLESS server on the Internet`
       
The problem:
When Xray tries to send VMess/VLESS traffic over WebSocket through an upstream HTTP-CONNECT proxy (Psiphon 3 on 127.0.0.1:10810), the proxy immediately responds with HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request, so the tunnel never forms and traffic falls back to the proxy’s own exit IP.

The same upstream proxy works perfectly for plain TCP links, and WebSocket also succeeds if you chain it with external software like Proxifier—so the failure is specific to Xray’s handling of WebSocket inside a CONNECT tunnel. 
 
 
Xray core: 25.6.8
Client: v2rayN 7.12.7 (Windows)
Upstream proxy: any HTTP/SOCKS proxy (here Psiphon3 desktop)

Example minimal config that works (Vmess, tcp, no tls):
```
{
  "inbounds":[
    {"tag":"socks-in","listen":"127.0.0.1","port":10808,"protocol":"mixed",
     "settings":{"auth":"noauth","udp":false}}],

  "outbounds":[
    {"tag":"upstream","protocol":"http",
     "settings":{"servers":[{"address":"127.0.0.1","port":10810}] }},

    {"tag":"remote","protocol":"vmess",
     "settings":{"vnext":[{"address":"<SERVER_A>","port":<PORT_A>,
       "users":[{"id":"<UUID_A>","alterId":0}]}]},
     "streamSettings":{"network":"tcp"},
     "proxySettings":{"tag":"upstream"}}
  ],

  "routing":{"rules":[{"type":"field","inboundTag":["socks-in"],"outboundTag":"remote"}]}
}

```

Example minimal config that fails (Vless, ws, tls):
```
 {
  "inbounds":[
    {"tag":"socks-in","listen":"127.0.0.1","port":10808,"protocol":"mixed",
     "settings":{"auth":"noauth","udp":false}}],

  "outbounds":[
    {"tag":"upstream","protocol":"http",
     "settings":{"servers":[{"address":"127.0.0.1","port":10810}] }},

    {"tag":"remote","protocol":"vless",
     "settings":{"vnext":[{"address":"<SERVER_B>","port":<PORT_B3>,
       "users":[{"id":"<UUID_B>","encryption":"none"}]}]},
     "streamSettings":{"network":"ws","security":"tls",
       "tlsSettings":{"allowInsecure":false},
       "wsSettings":{"path":"/"}},
     "proxySettings":{"tag":"upstream"}}
  ],

  "routing":{"rules":[{"type":"field","inboundTag":["socks-in"],"outboundTag":"remote"}]}
}
```

Docs consulted
The only official note on outbound proxy-chaining is here:
[https://guide.v2fly.org/advanced/outboundproxy.html#基本代理转发](https://guide.v2fly.org/advanced/outboundproxy.html#%E5%9F%BA%E6%9C%AC%E4%BB%A3%E7%90%86%E8%BD%AC%E5%8F%91)
…but that page hasn’t been updated in years and doesn’t mention WebSocket at all.

Questions
Is HTTP-CONNECT → WebSocket officially supported in Xray?

Does Xray forward the WS handshake verbatim through the local proxy tunnel?

Any flag or patch to make Xray log the upstream proxy’s full HTTP response?

Anyone successfully using WebSocket outbound through a local proxy—what’s your config?

Thanks!

_Originally posted by @Pyrzoes in https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/discussions/7547_

author: DanyPrinceOP

title: webRTC leak bug in full tunnel mode on Linux
body:
Hey there,
So I was checking leak tests and I happened to do some webRTC leak tests as well. I tried with multiple websites. Two websites in particular were able to know my REAL IP even though the full tunnel mode was active. For most actions they still saw my VPN address, but when the website uses the webRTC API to make a call to STUN servers, my real IP leaked. I tested on chrome and brave and both of them showed there was a leak. 
Then I tested with nekoray for linux (latest version and version from early 2023) and none of them had the leak issues. 
webRTC on linux uses the "binding to interface" socket option. If an app binds its socket to the physical interface (wifi card or ethernet card), it will bypass the VPN tunnel (i.e. the IP rule and IP routing tables). The fix is to reject these packets with the help of the linux kernel firewall "netfilter". 

The websites that were able to find the leak: 
https://youproxy.io/en/tools/check-webrtc/  (if IP from the website matches the real WAN IP, it's a leak.
https://www.browserscan.net/webrtc if IP from at least one of the STUN servers is your real IP, it's a leak.

title: [Feature request]: 增加客户端限速功能。
body:
### 相关问题

问题产生原因：因为下载较大的资料，导致我账号被停了。可能影响到了其他人的使用，但我没有太有效的手段控制本地下载的速度。



### 描述你希望的解决方案

限制客户端的瞬时流量，限制每秒传输的数据量（带宽）

1.全局限速，每秒不超过多少kb/mb **（重要功能）**，因为服务器一般可能不限速，但是这回干扰其他用户使用。
2.控制每个请求最大不超过全局限制的百分比，比如50%。**（可选功能）**
3.每天不超过多少GB,超过后提示。**（重要功能）**


### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

 netlimiter 但收费，而且依赖外部软件并不很好的方案。

title: [Bug]: Bad passwords for Tun mode causes repeated sudo failures, triggering PAM faillock lockout
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Arch Linux latest

### 预期情况

Enable Tun若输入错误密码，不应多次尝试登录，触发pam faillock。

### 实际情况

Enable Tun若输入错误密码，会不断重试，导致触发pam faillock锁定用户。`pam_faillock.so`默认配置下，15分钟内连续输入三次密码，会将用户账户（登录、sudo操作等）锁定。

建议增加密码错误提醒，在登录失败后向用户请求新密码，而不是多次重试密码。

### 复现方法

在启用pam faillock的Linux系统下，使能Tun mode并输入错误密码。然后测试用户的sudo是否出现`pam_unix(sudo:auth): conversation failed`的问题。

### 日志信息

[sudo] password for ***: Sorry, try again.
[sudo] password for ***: Sorry, try again

### 额外信息

可使用`faillock --user username --reset`命令解锁。

title: [Feature request]: 前置代理支持多节点自动切换
body:
### 相关问题

1. 当我使用节点A的时候，设置了节点1作为节点A的前置代理；
2. 可能会遇到的情况是，当作为前置代理的节点1失效后，就会导致整个连接链的中断；
3. 因此，是否能支持设置多个前置代理节点，例如允许添加节点1、节点2、节点3，3个已经足够了，不需要特别多；
4. 之后，引入一个自动检测机制，例如每隔一段时间检查节点1的连通状态，如果节点1是断开的，那么自动切换为节点2作为节点A的前置代理；

===================================================================================

When I use node A, I set node 1 as node A’s upstream proxy.

A possible issue is that if the upstream proxy node 1 fails, the entire connection chain will be interrupted.

Therefore, is it possible to support setting multiple upstream proxy nodes? For example, allowing nodes 1, 2, and 3 to be added—three nodes should be enough; no need for too many.

After that, introduce an automatic detection mechanism that checks node 1’s connectivity status at regular intervals. If node 1 is disconnected, it would automatically switch to node 2 as node A’s upstream proxy.

### 描述你希望的解决方案

但是，这个自动检测机制我没想好还，因为如果设置每5秒检测一次，会导致前置代理节点发送请求太过频繁，可能会导致连接的检测服务器认为前置代理节点是恶意的，导致前置代理节点被对应检测服务器封杀ip；

初步的想法就是有两种，主动检测与被动检测，或者主动+被动

# 方案一：主动式检查

可能的解决途径就是**选择合适的检测目标（URL）：** 不要检测 `www.google.com` 或 `www.baidu.com` 这种大型商业网站。使用专门用于连通性测试的、轻量级的、不会有复杂的风控策略的URL，例如：

*   `http://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204`
*   `http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204`
*   `http://detectportal.firefox.com/success.txt`

1.  **设置合理的超时（Timeout）：** 检测请求设置一个较短的超时时间，比如3-5秒。如果在这个时间内没有收到响应，就可以认为节点可能存在问题。
2.  **引入“失败阈值”：** 不要因为一次检测失败就立刻判定节点失效。可以设置一个阈值，例如“**连续3次检测失败**，才将节点标记为不可用”。这样可以有效防止因网络瞬间抖动造成的误判。

# 方案二：被动式检查

**核心思想：** **平时不检测，出错时再切换。**

工作流程如下：

1.  **正常工作：** 系统默认使用节点1作为前置代理。所有来自节点A的请求都通过节点1转发。
2.  **检测失败：** 当节点A通过节点1发起一个**真实连接**时（比如打开一个网页），如果这个连接失败了（例如TCP连接超时、握手失败等），V2rayN捕捉到这个失败事件。
3.  **立即切换：** 在捕捉到失败后，**立即**将节点1标记为“暂时不可用”（并为其设置一个“冷却时间”，例如5分钟），然后**自动**使用节点2来**重试**刚才失败的那个连接。对于上层应用（比如浏览器）来说，它只是感觉第一次连接慢了一点（因为要等待节点1超时），但请求最终成功了，整个过程是自动且无感知的。
4.  **自动恢复：** 在节点1的“冷却时间”（比如5分钟）过后，系统会将其重新放回可用列表。下次有新的连接请求时，可以再次尝试使用节点1。如果它依然失败，就再次进入冷却；如果成功，它就恢复正常工作。

# 方案三：主动+被动策略

1.  **主要机制 - 被动检测：**
    *   日常连接使用**被动检测**机制。当主节点（节点1）在处理真实请求时失败，立即切换到备用节点（节点2），并对节点1进行短暂“惩罚”（例如5分钟内不使用）。

2.  **辅助机制 - 主动检测：**
    *   系统在后台运行一个**低频率的、优化的主动检测**任务（例如每10分钟一次）。
        *   **探测恢复：** 检查那些被“惩罚”的节点是否已经恢复正常。如果恢复了，就将其移出“惩罚”列表。
        *   **择优选择：** 不仅仅是检查“通/不通”，还可以测量所有可用节点（节点1, 2, 3）的延迟（Latency）。然后自动选择**延迟最低**的那个节点作为当前的主节点。


===================================================================================

However, I haven’t finalized the automatic detection mechanism yet, because if detection occurs every 5 seconds, the front proxy node will send requests too frequently, which might cause the detection server to perceive the front proxy node as malicious and block its IP.

The initial ideas fall into two categories: active detection and passive detection, or a combination of both.

# Plan One: Active Checking

A possible solution is to **choose appropriate detection targets (URLs):** avoid checking large commercial websites like `www.google.com` or `www.baidu.com`. Instead, use URLs specifically designed for connectivity testing—lightweight and without complex security policies—such as:

* `http://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204`
* `http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204`
* `http://detectportal.firefox.com/success.txt`

1.  **Set a reasonable timeout:** Configure detection requests with a short timeout, for example, 3–5 seconds. If no response arrives within this time, the node may be considered problematic.
2.  **Introduce a "failure threshold":** Don’t mark a node as invalid after just one failed check. For example, set a threshold like "**mark the node unavailable only after 3 consecutive failures**." This effectively prevents false positives caused by transient network glitches.

# Plan Two: Passive Checking

**Core idea:** **Do not check regularly; switch only when a failure occurs.**

Workflow:

1.  **Normal operation:** The system defaults to using node 1 as the front proxy. All requests from node A are routed through node 1.
2.  **Failure detection:** When node A makes a **real connection** through node 1 (like opening a webpage), if the connection fails (e.g., TCP timeout, handshake failure), V2rayN captures this failure event.
3.  **Immediate switch:** Upon catching the failure, node 1 is **immediately** marked as “temporarily unavailable” (with a “cooldown period,” for example, 5 minutes), and node 2 is **automatically** used to **retry** the failed connection.
4.  **Seamless experience:** For the applications on top (like a browser), the only noticeable effect is a slightly slower first connection (waiting for node 1’s timeout), but the request ultimately succeeds, and the entire process is automatic and transparent.
5.  **Automatic recovery:** After node 1’s cooldown period (for example, 5 minutes) expires, the system returns it to the available list. The next time a connection attempt occurs, it will try node 1 again. If it fails again, it re-enters cooldown; if it succeeds, it resumes normal operation.

# Plan Three: Active + Passive Strategy

1.  **Primary mechanism – passive detection:**
    *  Use **passive detection** for everyday connections. When the primary node (node 1) fails during a real request, switch immediately to the backup node (node 2) and apply a short “penalty” to node 1 (e.g., avoid using it for 5 minutes).
    *  This ensures **instant response** to failures and **uninterrupted connections**.
2.  **Secondary mechanism – active detection:**
    *  Run a **low-frequency, optimized active detection** task in the background (for example, once every 10 minutes).
    *  The purposes of this task are:
        *  **Recovery probe:** Check if nodes under “penalty” have recovered; if so, remove them from the penalty list.
        *  **Optimal selection:** Beyond simple reachability checks, measure the latency of all available nodes (nodes 1, 2, 3) and then automatically select the node with the **lowest latency** as the current primary node.

title: [Bug]: Sing-box core fails to start in v7.13.6 due to deprecated special outbounds
body:
### 操作系统和版本

v2rayN Version: 7.13.6, Operating System: Windows 11 

### 预期情况

The sing-box core should start successfully and establish a proxy connection.

### 实际情况

When sing-box is selected as the core, the service fails to start immediately. The application shows a "Failed to run Core" error message in the log window.

### 复现方法

1. Use a fresh installation of v2rayN v7.13.6.
2. Go to Settings -> Core Settings.
3. Select `sing-box` as the active core and confirm.
4. Select any server and set it as the active server.
5. The core fails to start and the error appears in the log.

### 日志信息

WARN[0000] legacy DNS servers is deprecated in sing-box 1.12.0 and will be removed in sing-box 1.14.0, checkout documentation for migration: https://sing-box.sagernet.org/migration/#migrate-to-new-dns-server-formats
ERROR[0000] legacy special outbounds is deprecated in sing-box 1.11.0 and will be removed in sing-box 1.13.0, checkout documentation for migration: https://sing-box.sagernet.org/migration/#migrate-legacy-special-outbounds-to-rule-actions
FATAL[0000] to continuing using this feature, set environment variable ENABLE_DEPRECATED_SPECIAL_OUTBOUNDS=true
Failed to run Core, please check the prompt information

### 额外信息

This appears to be the same issue as reported in #7702 and #7698.

**Important Workaround:** The application works perfectly if I switch the core to **`Xray`** in the Core Settings. This seems to be a reliable temporary fix for users experiencing this problem.

title: [Bug]: WebRTC IP Leak: Real Public IP Is Exposed Despite Active Connection
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 10 Pro (also reproducible on Windows 11) Browser: Chrome / Firefox  v2rayN version: latest stable

### 预期情况

When connected through v2rayN, all outgoing IP-related traffic — including WebRTC/STUN/ICE — should be routed through the proxy tunnel. The WebRTC IP reported in browser tests should match the tunnel IP or be disabled entirely to avoid IP leaks.

### 实际情况

WebRTC tests show the real ISP public IP address, which leaks the user's real location. This compromises privacy and defeats the purpose of using a tunnel.

### 复现方法

Set up and connected to a v2ray server via v2rayN using VMess/VLESS (tried TCP and gRPC)

Verified traffic is tunneled by checking the public IP (OK)

Visited https://browserleaks.com/webrtc

Found that WebRTC reveals my real ISP IP, not the proxy IP

### 日志信息

Not relevant to this bug (no crash or GUI error)



### 额外信息

Hidify Comparison: Same config, same browser and system, tested with Hidify client → no IP leak via WebRTC

author: maryjeck

title: [Bug] Subscription group settings need validation before applying.
body:
**Situation:**
The internet connection requires users to enter login and password on a captive portal.
V2RayN has a subscription group configured with an auto-update.
When the user hasn't entered login and password yet, the auto-update URL is not available, and the ISP returns an HTML of the captive portal instead.
V2RayN treats this returned data as a custom mihomo config of some sort, replaces existing configurations, and stops working because the new config is obviously invalid.

**Solution:**
When downloading Subscription group config, do some validation of the contents before applying it. At least, make sure it's not an HTML page (grep for `<html>, <head>, <body>` in the returned data)...

V2RayN v7.13.2

title: [Bug]: 电脑非休眠息屏后风扇疯狂转
body:
### 操作系统和版本

windows11家庭中文 24H2 26100.4946

### 预期情况

 电脑非休眠息屏后风扇疯狂转

### 实际情况

 电脑非休眠息屏后风扇疯狂转

### 复现方法

设置 休眠时间为从不，几分钟后关闭我的屏幕，息屏后五秒左右风扇声音明显增大，已经排除过了，只要关掉v2rayN就不会出现这种情况。

title: [Bug]: xray 作为出站核心，Tun 不可用
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 10 2009

### 预期情况

none

### 实际情况

7.14.0 后出现问题

xray 出站流量默认行为是直接发域名，由系统负责解析发送
当开启 tun 后，xray 发往代理服务器的系统 dns 解析可能被 sing-box 拦截，导致无法使用
7.14.0 之前 v2rayN 显式将代理服务器域名写入 sing-box 的 dns 直连列表，所以没问题

### 复现方法

none

author: DFBB2010

title: Linux 版本使用 `CAP_NET_ADMIN` 解决权限问题
body:
## 问题简述

#7116 中我建议通过赋予 sing-box 内核 `CAP_NET_ADMIN` 属性，避免储存或反复输入密码。

很抱歉，我给出的命令有误，经过测试，这个方案是可行的。

原本的命令是 `sudo setcap CAP_NET_ADMIN+ep sing-box`，问题出在 sing-box 在创建虚拟网卡设备时，会 fork 3 个子进程，而这些子进程不会继承属性，这就导致了：

> 运行sing-box tun 配置后，确实可以跑起来了，但是还是缺少权限，会要求 3 次权限请求提示，这样这个方式就无法解决问题了。

## 解决方案

```bash
sudo setcap CAP_NET_ADMIN+eip sing-box
```

其中 `i` 表示继承（inherited）。

如果开发者不原因将这条命令加入安装包脚本，也可以在 Wiki 中说明让用户自己添加。然后就可以删除（或选择性启用）那个 sudo 密码的对话框了。

## 测试

v2rayN 7.13.8

在上次关闭 v2rayN 不关闭 TUN 时（TUN 相关配置仍保留在配置文件中）：

```bash
cd /opt/v2rayn-bin
sudo setcap CAP_NET_ADMIN+eip ./bin/sing_box/sing-box
./bin/sing_box/sing-box run -c ./binConfigs/config.json
```

成功运行，TUN 正常。

## 题外话

昨天研究了代码，似乎 Hysteria2 的 `up_mbps`、`down_mbps` 和 `hop_interval` 是写死在源码里的？是否可以添加设置，默认的 30 秒跳跃间隔在 QoS 往死里整的地区不太够用。（我就在这种地区，之前都是 1 秒跳跃。）

title: [Bug]: Conflict between Wireguard and V2RayN's Tun mode on MacOS.
body:
### 操作系统和版本

MacOS Sequoia 15.6.1

### 预期情况

V2RayN can send traffic to Wireguard in Tun mode.

### 实际情况

My network configuration is as follows:
My MacOS computer is on a large LAN that cannot connect to the internet. At another location, a server is connected to this large LAN and running a WireGuard service. Another network port on this server is connected to a router that can access the internet. This server forwards data from the VPN network segment to the router's network segment, enabling my computer connected to the WireGuard VPN to access the internet. In this scenario, I used V2RayN as a proxy. The connection functions normally without TUN mode enabled. However, enabling TUN mode triggers an error: ERROR connection: open outbound connection: dial tcp [Server2IP]:443: connect: network is unreachable (Note: “Server2” here refers to the public-facing server, not the one within the large LAN). This indicates that in TUN mode, all data intended for the WireGuard connection to the internet is instead being sent directly to the large LAN, which lacks internet connectivity. Through testing, I discovered that restarting WireGuard when this issue occurs causes the “Current Latency” displayed in the bottom-right corner of V2RayN in TUN mode to change from -1 to an actual value, such as 230ms. However, traffic intended for V2RayN now flows directly to WireGuard instead of first passing through V2RayN to connect to Server2IP:443. In this scenario, WireGuard effectively hijacks all traffic destined for V2RayN. I've attempted to find solutions but have yet to resolve this conflict. I tested this behavior on Windows, where traffic successfully traverses V2RayN's TUN mode before connecting to the internet via WireGuard.



### 复现方法

Step 1: Connect to WireGuard and configure WireGuard settings as follows:
[Interface]
PrivateKey = *****
Address = 192.168.3.2/32
[Peer]
PublicKey = *****
AllowedIPs = All IP subnets except the subnet containing the Endpoint (if the Endpoint is 192.168.1.1:10000, then AllowedIPs should be
0.0.0.0/1, 128.0.0.1/2, 193.0.0.0/8, 194.0.0.0/7, 196.0.0.0/6, 200.0.0.0/5, 208.0.0.0/4, 224.0.0.0/3)
Endpoint = ServerIP:ServerPort
PersistentKeepalive = 25
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

VLEES
Adresse: XXX.XXX.XXX
Port: 443
ID: *****

Verschlüsselung: keine

Netzwerk tcp
Typ keine

SNI www.learn.microsoft.com
Fingerabdruck Chrome
PublicKey *****
ShortID *****
SpiderX /
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Step 3: Set to “Automatically configure as system proxy” and “Global proxy,” then enable TUN mode.

title: [Feature request]: 增加32位Debian Linux的打包
body:
### 相关问题

32位处理器虽然老旧，Windows上运行非常卡顿，但是在Linux上依旧可以流畅运行，官方可能出于考虑在7.0时移除了32位Windows的支持，这使得32位处理器的用户陷入了较为被动的局面，尤其是新出的AnyTLS和xhttp协议，因此希望官方增加32位Linux的支持。

### 描述你希望的解决方案

通过PR，增加32位deb文件打包，直到上游结束32位的支持。

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

近期测试了32位处理器，在32位处理器上运行Windows已经是不明智的选择，但发现其运行Linux依旧可以有很好的体验。

如果可以，我会PR一份32位deb的打包文件，可以通过Workflow一键打包32位v2rayN Linux安装包，这个文件独立于现在的Linux打包文件，方便后续无法支持时一键移除。和package-rhel文件一样，采用netcore方式打包，无需再额外添加其他库文件。

title: [Feature request]: 设为活动配置文件前检查，选择配置文件界面，以及复杂ProfileItem
body: ### 原因 - 设为活动配置文件前检查 * 链式代理，节点分流，如果配置文件别名填错或不支持，应该显式通知用户 - 选择配置文件界面 * 用户友好，选择切换更方便 * 为 `复杂 ProfileItem` 做铺垫 - 复杂 ProfileItem * 多配置文件，最终配置随当前的路由等设置改变，而不是现在的生成为自定义配置 * 可支持无限长链式代理 * 可在节点分流中支持多节点 ### 实现细节 前两个大概构思了下代码实现，应该是可以的 #### 设为活动配置文件前检查 在调用 SetDefaultServer 前检查，新增一个 Helper 或者 ProfileItem 里新增一个函数，若检查不通过，则弹出提示并 return #### 选择配置文件界面 抽取出来 ProfilesListView UserControls，只负责显示配置文件列表和选择的配置文件，并提供若干“内容插槽” 新建一个 SelectProfilesDialog，包含 ProfilesListView，最后选择结果写到一个属性中，用法和 OpenFileDialog 类似 ProfilesView 包含 ProfilesListView，将右键菜单和“新增/编辑订阅”按钮放进插槽里 大概长这样 #### 复杂 ProfileItem ProfileItem 加入 `List? IndexId, EMultipleLoad? multipleLoad`，代码上 `CoreConfigService` 应该需要部分重写，将现有的 `List` 传参替换为 `ProfileItem`，其他代码将其视为 custom ConfigType

author: Lippiece

title: [Feature request]: 支持 Windows 自定义系统代理格式
body:
### 相关问题

在 Windows 平台上，```设置 - 参数设置 - 系统代理设置 - 高级代理设置，协议选择（可选）```选项目前仅支持几种预设格式，不支持自行填写。如果直接修改 guiNConfig.json 进行自定义，与直接修改注册表相比似乎存在额外的格式限制（具体见下文）。

### 描述你希望的解决方案

希望能支持自行填写该选项、能兼容更多格式，自行填写的内容/格式与选项类似，样例：
```{ip}:{http_port};socks={ip}:{socks_port}```

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

我目前遇到的情况是需要设置```{ip}:{http_port};socks={ip}:{socks_port}```这种格式以解决部分二游与系统代理不兼容的问题，但我想其他人有可能会需要其他格式以兼容其他应用，增加选项不如自定义更通用，所以希望能支持自定义该选项。

我尝试过将该选项选为默认的“空”、退出 v2rayN、直接在 guiNConfig.json 里设置```"SystemProxyAdvancedProtocol": "{ip}:{http_port};socks={ip}:{socks_port}"```、再启动 v2rayN，但最终写入到注册表的内容会是```http=127.0.0.1:10808;https=127.0.0.1:10808;ftp=127.0.0.1:10808;socks=127.0.0.1:10808```，与预期不符。

直接运行```reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings" /v ProxyServer /t REG_SZ /d "127.0.0.1:10808;socks=127.0.0.1:10808" /f```则能在注册表内写入符合预期的内容且正常生效。

title: [Feature request]: Add v2rayN window available to CMD+TAB list on Mac
body:
### 相关问题

On macOS there’s an issue: the v2rayN window doesn’t appear in the CMD+TAB (Alt+Tab) app switcher. When I’m actively working with v2rayN—tweaking its settings while constantly switching to another app (e.g., a browser) and back—the usual CMD+TAB workflow doesn’t work. I have to click the menu bar icon → “Display GUI” every time, which is inconvenient and frustrating. Request: please make the v2ray window show up in the Alt+Tab list.

### 描述你希望的解决方案

On macOS, apps only show up in Cmd+Tab if they run as regular foreground apps. Many menu-bar utilities (sounds like v2rayN on your Mac is packaged this way) are built as agent / accessory apps: their Info.plist sets LSUIElement (agent) or LSBackgroundOnly, or the app sets an activation policy of .accessory instead of .regular. Those apps have a menu-bar icon, no Dock icon, and don’t appear in Cmd+Tab by design.  What the developer needs to change so it shows up:  Turn off agent/background mode (LSUIElement=false, LSBackgroundOnly=false in Info.plist).  Ensure the app uses a regular activation policy (NSApp.setActivationPolicy(.regular)), and optionally provides a Dock icon.  Make the main window a normal app window and activate the app when opening it (activateIgnoringOtherApps:true).

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

title: [Bug]: Windows 下 TUN inbound 偶尔启动失败：The device is not ready for use
body:
### 操作系统和版本

客户端：v2rayN V7.14.10 (x64)  核心：Xray 25.9.11   模式：TUN inbound (tun-in)  系统：Windows 11 24H2 10.0.26100.0  权限：管理员运行

### 预期情况

TUN 接口应在首次启动时成功初始化。

### 实际情况

开机或首次登录后启动 v2rayN 时，TUN inbound 偶尔初始化失败。
失败时 15 秒超时后直接报错退出。
再次点击“重新启动服务”几乎总是能成功，不需要修改任何配置。
线路和 SOCKS 出口均正常，只有 TUN 初始化失败。
首次启动时偶尔报错，日志中出现：

open interface take too much time to finish!

configure tun interface: The device is not ready for use.

### 复现方法

启动 Windows 并登录。

自动或手动立即运行 v2rayN。

TUN 初始化，部分情况下失败。

点击“重新启动服务” → 正常。

复现频率：间歇性（一周内出现 1–3 次），多发生在登录后立刻启动时

### 日志信息

启动服务 (2025/09/21 07:47:02)...
Xray 25.9.11 (Xray, Penetrates Everything.) 3edfb0e (go1.25.1 windows/amd64)
2025/09/21 07:47:02.588937 [Warning] core: Xray 25.9.11 started
...
2025/09/21 07:47:13 WARN inbound/tun[tun-in]: open interface take too much time to finish!

启动服务 (2025/09/21 07:48:12)...
Xray 25.9.11 (Xray, Penetrates Everything.) 3edfb0e (go1.25.1 windows/amd64)
2025/09/21 07:48:13.896929 [Warning] core: Xray 25.9.11 started
...
2025/09/21 07:48:24 WARN inbound/tun[tun-in]: open interface take too much time to finish!
FATAL[0015] start service: start inbound/tun[tun-in]: configure tun interface: The device is not ready for use.


### 额外信息

启动时Wintun 未就绪：Windows 登录后，网络栈和虚拟网卡驱动可能尚未完全初始化，Xray 提前尝试创建 TUN → 15 秒超时后报错。

随后再次启动时驱动已就绪 → 可以正常工作。
是否可以在 TUN 初始化失败时 自动重试 ？

或者在 检测到网络/驱动就绪后再初始化 TUN？

是否可以让 TUN 初始化超时时间可配置，避免 Windows 上偶尔 15 秒不够的问题？

### 操作系统和版本

win10

### 预期情况

应该都能Ping通

### 实际情况

本人使用edgetunnel在cloudflare搭建的节点， 在win10系统中使用V2rayN软件更新订阅链接后，测延时发现所有的延时都是-1，而且节点不通。但是同样的订阅链接和节点在安卓版本的V2ranNg和win10系统的clash-verge上面都没有问题， 每个节点都可以正常使用。问下这是什么原因，是软件本身的问题吗？

### 复现方法

没有进行任何操作，软件重启情况依然存在

body:

title: [Feature Request]: Avoid password prompt for TUN when running as root (Linux)
body:
### 相关问题

If the application is already running as root, it should enable TUN mode without asking for a password. Entering the password every single time when running as root feels unnecessary and a bit exhausting.

### 描述你希望的解决方案

Add a check to detect if the application is running as root.  If running as root, enable TUN without prompting for a password.  If not, proceed with the usual password prompt.

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

Alternatively, we could configure sudoers with NOPASSWD for just the Sing-box binary, so the password is only required the first time.

title: 我找到了在v2rayN上如何使用新版本BPB链接的新方法
body: 在BPB Logo BPB Panel v3.5.3上实现。估计以后的版本都可以。因为bpb-panel作者拒绝再恢复原来的normal链接方式。 1. 先复制normal下的链接： 2. 打开v2rayN，并建立现的订阅组，粘贴此链接； 3. 更新当前订阅；出现的结果如下图所示： 4. 修改该订阅组的“订阅转换目标类型”为v2ray： 5. 然后即可设为活动链接即可使用了。 缺点是：v2rayN改订阅组中面板的显示依然不是原来上面字段对应的各项；测试真是速度的时候也看不到。 另外注意：千万不要在没有订阅出结果之前就改变“订阅转换目标类型”，不然不会出订阅结果的。 2025.9.24

title: Feature Request: Add Kill Switch Feature to v2rayN
body:
Dear v2rayN Developer,

I hope this message finds you well. I would like to propose a feature request for the v2rayN project. It would be incredibly useful to have a Kill Switch option integrated into the client. This feature would allow users to automatically block all internet traffic if the VPN connection drops, ensuring that no data is leaked when the VPN is disconnected or interrupted.

As VPNs are used primarily for privacy and security, having a built-in Kill Switch would greatly enhance the protection and usability of v2rayN. This feature would provide an extra layer of safety, especially for users who rely on a secure and uninterrupted connection.

It would be greatly appreciated if you could consider implementing this feature in a future release. Please feel free to reach out if you need more details or clarification regarding this request.

Thank you for your hard work and continued efforts on v2rayN!

Best regards,

title: [Feature Enhancement]: `Persistent Tun Mode` Across Reboots / App Restarts
body:
@2dust 
First of all, thank you for the fantastic work you’re doing and for continuously improving this software. It’s already a great tool, and this small enhancement could make the user experience even better.
 ______________________________________

Currently, `Tun Mode` requires elevated privileges (via sudo) to enable, which is understood and appropriate from a security standpoint. However, the application does not persist the user’s preference for Tun Mode between application restarts, system reboots, or exits. As a result, the user must re-enable Tun Mode manually each time and re-enter their sudo password.

This behavior introduces unnecessary friction for users who rely on Tun Mode as their default networking method.
Introduce a mechanism to persist Tun Mode status across reboots and app sessions, with an explicit user-controlled setting.

## 🔹 **Proposed Implementation**

1️⃣ **Add a user preference toggle/checkbox in Tun Mode settings:**

Example label:
`[ ] Automatically enable Tun Mode on startup`

2️⃣ **On first activation:**

User enables Tun Mode manually
Application prompts for sudo credentials (existing behavior)
If the checkbox is selected:
Store the preference in app config (e.g., JSON, plist, registry, or equivalent depending on platform)

3️⃣ **On application startup:**

During initialization, check the stored user preference
If `persistentTunMode == true:`
auto-attempt to enable Tun Mode

reuse previously authorized permissions or request system-level persistence via OS mechanism (launch agent/service, polkit, helper daemon, etc.)



✅ **Security Considerations**

Initial privilege elevation still required
No bypass of sudo/auth prompt unless OS-approved persistence method is used
User explicitly opts in to the behavior
Local preference storage only (no remote sync)

✅ **User Benefit**

Eliminates repeated manual toggling
Reduces authentication friction
Matches expectations of users who treat Tun Mode as default
Enhances workflow efficiency without compromising privilege controls

✅ **Optional Additions (If Viable):**

Graceful fallback if auto-start of Tun Mode fails
Log entry or notification for startup errors
GUI warning if preference is set but permissions are insufficient

__________________________________

Thank you in advance for considering this feature and helping enhance an already excellent application. 🙏

title: [Bug]: tun 模式下无法使用 wireguard 节点
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 11 

### 预期情况

tun 模式下应该可以使用 wireguard

### 实际情况

V2rayN: 7.14.12
singbox: 1.12.1

在没有开启 TUN 模式情况下，wireguard节点工作正常，可以通过系统代理使 Edge 浏览器路由 wireguard 节点上网。
开启 TUN 模式之后：

1. wireguard 节点无法工作，应该是 8.8.8.8 的 DNS 无法通过 wireguard 节点解析到IP。
2. 切换到其他非 wireguard 类型节点，可以工作
3. 无论什么类型节点，状态栏测速一栏永远显示 -1 ；对于 wireguard 节点，上不了网；对于非 wireguard 类型节点，虽然状态显示 -1 ，但实际可以上网。
4. wireguard服务器我已经选择了IP直连

### 复现方法

1. 选择 wiregaurd 类型节点
2. 启动 TUN 模式
3. 通过 Edge 浏览器上网

title: [Bug]: v2rayN crashes under real-time kernel
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Ubuntu 24.04, Kernel 6.8.1-1035-realtime (PREEMPT_RT), v2rayN-V7.15.1-X86

### 预期情况

v2rayN 应该能够在 Ubuntu 6.8.1-1035-realtime (PREEMPT_RT) 内核下正常运行，不会触发崩溃或 GUI 暂时消失。Translation: v2rayN should run normally on Ubuntu 6.8.1-1035-realtime (PREEMPT_RT) kernel without crashing or causing the GUI to disappear.

### 实际情况

运行 v2rayN 后立即触发 libc.so.6 的 general protection fault，屏幕变黑并失去输入响应，几分钟后 GUI 恢复，但所有应用程序消失。非实时内核下运行正常。
After running v2rayN, it immediately triggers a general protection fault in libc.so.6, the screen goes black and input stops responding, and a few minutes later the GUI returns but all applications are gone. Works fine on non-RT kernels.

### 复现方法

1. 安装 Ubuntu 24.04 并升级到 6.8.1-1035-realtime (PREEMPT_RT) 内核。  
2. 安装 v2rayN 并确保依赖库完整。  
3. 启动 v2rayN。  
4. 稍等几秒钟至几分钟，系统出现 general protection fault 并触发 GUI 暂时失效。  


### 日志信息

错误发生时的 dmesg 关键日志：

[02:40:35] sched: RT throttling activated
[02:40:37] traps: v2rayN[4773] general protection fault ip:... in libc.so.6
[02:40:44] fbcon: Taking over console

title: [Bug]: DNS resolver for Singbox
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 11 — v2rayN 7.14.12 (with latest stable cores)

### 预期情况

In one of the recent updates, I noticed that the DNS resolver in Sing-box configurations no longer works as intended.

### 实际情况

In one of the recent updates, I noticed that the DNS resolver in Sing-box configurations does not work as intended. After some investigation, I found that it uses the server’s DNS instead of my client settings.

By exporting the URL configuration to JSON, I discovered a rule like this:
`      {
        "outbound": "proxy",
        "port_range": [
          "0:65535"
        ]
      },
      {
        "action": "resolve",
        "strategy": "ipv4_only"
      }`

This rule order causes the problem.
If we switch it to:

`      {
        "action": "resolve",
        "strategy": "ipv4_only"
      },
      {
        "outbound": "proxy",
        "port_range": [
          "0:65535"
        ]
      }`
the issue is fixed.

### 复现方法

Use a basic DNS configuration such as:

`{
  "servers": [
    {
      "server": "security.cloudflare-dns.com",
      "domain_resolver": "hosts_dns",
      "path": "/dns-query",
      "type": "https",
      "tag": "remote_dns",
      "detour": "proxy"
    },
    {
      "predefined": {
        "security.cloudflare-dns.com": [
          "1.1.1.2",
          "1.0.0.2"
        ]
      },
      "type": "hosts",
      "tag": "hosts_dns"
    }
  ],
  "rules": [],
  "final": "remote_dns",
  "independent_cache": false
}`

Then, set the client to Global Mode.
You will notice that, regardless of which resolver you configure, the system still uses the server’s DNS settings.

### 日志信息

no log needed

_No response_

title: [Feature request]: 遇到不支持的Linux桌面环境时，转为通过修改环境变量进行适配 Fallback to modifying env variables when encountering unsupported Linux desktop environment
body:
### 相关问题

v2rayN cannot set / clear system proxy settings in by itself Linux system without Gnome or KDE as desktop enviroment.
v2rayN 无法在未采用 Gnome 或 KDE 作为桌面环境的 Linux 系统中自行设置 / 清除系统代理。

### 描述你希望的解决方案

v2rayN is able to configuring system proxy across all desktop environments of Linux.
v2rayN能够在Linux的所有桌面环境中配置系统代理。

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

As described in [this issue](https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/issues/7059), the process of configuring system proxy in Linux only consists checking Gnome and KDE environment and apply corresponding bash scripts, v2rayN doesn't do anything if it fails to detect desktop environment or it's unsupported, which is confusing for some Linux users.

v2rayN can be optimized to perform the routine when `set system proxy`:
1. check system DE and apply corresponding script if detected
2. fallback to setting and activating **user-level** environment variables `https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:${port}` `http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:{$port}` where `${port}` is the `Mixed Port` option in `core: basic settings` (default `10808`).

Vice versa, when clearing proxy:
1. check system DE and apply corresponding script if detected
2. fallback to delete environment variables `https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:${port}` `http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:{$port}`.

如[此问题](https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/issues/7059)所述，Linux系统代理配置过程仅需检测Gnome和KDE环境并应用对应的bash脚本。若v2rayN无法检测到桌面环境或检测到不支持的环境，则不会执行任何操作，这会让部分Linux用户感到困惑。

可优化v2rayN在执行`set system proxy`时的流程：
1. 检测系统桌面环境，若检测到则应用对应脚本
2. 默认设置并激活**用户级**环境变量 `https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:${port}` `http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:{$port}`，其中 `${port}` 取自 `核心：基础设置` 中的 `混合端口`选项 （默认值为`10808`）。

反之，清除代理时：
1. 检测系统桌面环境，若存在则执行对应脚本
2. 否则删除环境变量`https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:${port}` `http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:{$port}`。

### Proposed Method 建议方法

**When writing environment variables 在写入环境变量时**:

```bash
cat > "~/.config/environment.d/v2rayn-env.conf" <<EOF
http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:$PROXY_PORT
https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:$PROXY_PORT
EOF
systemctl --user import-environment http_proxy https_proxy
```

**When erasing 在擦除时**:

```bash
rm -f "~/.config/environment.d/v2rayn-env.conf"
systemctl --user import-environment -- http_proxy https_proxy
```

title: [Bug]: 完整配置模板设置-设置上游代理tag不生效
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows11

### 预期情况

设置上游代理tag后，生成的config.json中应该将outbound的streamSettings.sockopt.dialerProxy设置为指定值

### 实际情况

未生成sockopt和dialerProxy，即设置上游代理tag不生效

### 复现方法

1. 确保订阅分组中没有设置“前置代理配置文件名”
2. 启用完整配置模板
3. 设置上游代理tag

### 软件日志

没有相关内容

### 内核日志

与本问题无关

### 额外信息

[V2rayConfigTemplateService.cs第100行](https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/blob/964572817be5de4497421344997e86bf8a289c54/v2rayN/ServiceLib/Services/CoreConfig/V2ray/V2rayConfigTemplateService.cs#L100)的if判断疑似存在问题
```cs
outbound.streamSettings?.sockopt?.dialerProxy.IsNullOrEmpty() == true
```
当`sockopt`为`null`时，`outbound.streamSettings?.sockopt?.dialerProxy.IsNullOrEmpty()`会被计算为`null`，而不是`true`或者`false`，`IsNullOrEmpty()`不会被调用

title: [Feature request]: Feature Request: Add MTU setting option for improved connection stability/performance
body:
### 相关问题

Hello! Thank you for the continuous development of v2rayN.  I would like to request the addition of a manual setting for MTU (Maximum Transmission Unit), ideally as a configurable field within the relevant server or tunnel settings (especially for protocols like VLESS, Trojan, and when using the TUN mode).  Reasoning:  Improved Stability in Restricted Networks: In some network environments, particularly those with heavy restrictions or complex routing (e.g., using PPPoE or mobile data), a lower MTU (e.g., 1400 or 1360) can significantly reduce packet fragmentation and improve connection stability.  Optimizing Performance: Allowing users to tune the MTU value can help avoid network overhead and fragmentation issues, leading to better overall performance and reduced latency, especially when network overhead (like in WireGuard or VLESS with padding) is a factor.

title: [Feature request]: 添加 Tun2Socks 作为 Singbox 代替品开启Tun
body:
### 相关问题

SingBox的sing-tun中添加了太多附加内容，当xray作为主要内核时，Singbox会处理很多步骤再将流量转发到xray的socks监听端口

### 描述你希望的解决方案

添加 Tun2Socks 作为 Singbox 替代 开启Tun

### 描述你所考虑的替代方案

Tun2Socks和Singbox一样，都是将原始数据包解析TCP/UDP，再由socks发给对应内核，与Singbox的处理相比，额外添加4MB的Tun2Socks对电脑的磁盘空间占用几乎无影响，其处理原始数据包更为高效，可以在内核设置里添加singbox和tun2socks作为TUN内核选择，打包包含tun2socks。

title: [Bug]: Fedora KDE 环境下 “自动配置系统代理” 写入格式与 KDE 系统设置不一致，可能导致 Firefox DoH 回退到明文 DNS
body: ### 操作系统和版本 Fedora 43 KDE ### 预期情况 Firefox 正常使用 DoH ### 实际情况 感谢2dust和其他贡献者的辛勤工作！ 我在 **Fedora 43 KDE** 环境下使用 **v2rayN** 时，发现了一个关于系统代理配置的格式问题，该问题似乎间接导致了 **Firefox** 浏览器的 DNS over HTTPS (DoH) 功能异常回退到明文 DNS。 #### **一、环境** * **操作系统:** Fedora 43 * **桌面环境:** KDE Plasma * **代理软件:** v2rayN * **浏览器:** Firefox #### **二、问题描述** 1. **使用 v2rayN “自动配置系统代理”后：** * 代理工作正常，但 **Firefox 浏览器**（在已指定 DoH 服务器，且设置为模式3，强制使用 DoH 的情况下）**会回退到明文 DNS**。 2. **在 KDE 设置中使用完全相同的设置手动配置完全相同的代理地址（如图）：** * 代理工作正常，且 **Firefox 浏览器** 能够**正常使用 DoH**。 只有通过 v2rayN 自动设置代理时，Firefox 的 DoH 功能才会失效并回退。 #### **三、排查与发现** 我对比了两种设置方式下，KDE 代理配置文件 `~/.config/kioslaverc` 的内容，发现了如下格式差异： **1. v2rayN 自动设置代理后的 `kioslaverc` 内容（端口号前有冒号 `:`）：** ``` [Proxy Settings] ... ftpProxy=http://127.0.0.1:10839 httpProxy=http://127.0.0.1:10839 httpsProxy=http://127.0.0.1:10839 socksProxy=http://127.0.0.1:10839 ``` **2. 在 KDE 系统设置中手动设置完全相同代理后的 `kioslaverc` 内容（端口号前是空格 ` `）：** ``` [Proxy Settings] ... ftpProxy=http://127.0.0.1 10839 httpProxy=http://127.0.0.1 10839 httpsProxy=http://127.0.0.1 10839 socksProxy=http://127.0.0.1 10839 ``` **差异点总结：** * **v2rayN:** 格式为 `协议://IP:端口` * **KDE 手动:** 格式为 `协议://IP 端口` （注意，`:` 被替换成了空格） 根据 v2rayN 的源代码 `/v2rayN/ServiceLib/Sample/proxy_set_linux_sh`，配置逻辑确实使用了冒号 `:` 作为 IP 和端口的分隔符。 #### **四、请求** **推测:** KDE/Kioslave 可能期望使用空格来分隔 IP 和端口。尽管冒号的格式在 URL 标准中是正确的，但 KDE 的配置解析器似乎更偏爱空格分隔的格式，或者这两种格式在解析时会产生不同的副作用。我怀疑正是 v2rayN 写入的 `http://$PROXY_IP:$PROXY_PORT` 格式，导致了 KDE 环境下某些软件（如 Firefox）在处理系统代理时出现了异常。 恳请您检查这件事。 如果问题确实由此引起，请将 `proxy_set_linux_sh` 脚本中写入 `kioslaverc` 的格式改为与 KDE 系统设置一致的 **"http://$PROXY_IP $PROXY_PORT"** （即 IP 与端口之间用空格分隔）；若问题是 Firefox 上游问题，请不吝指教斧正。 期待您的回复。 ### 复现方法 在 Fedora 43 KDE 中使用 v2rayN “自动配置系统代理” ### 软件日志 2025-11-04 00:26:22.6855-INFO v2rayN 支持为hysteria2单个节点配置上下行速度和支持修改端口跳跃时间

### 描述你希望的解决方案

目前v2rayN在对hysteria2的上下行速度进行处理时，是在**设置->参数**设置里面进行统一配置以使用brutal的拥塞控制算法。

这是非常不合理的，因为每个节点对应的服务器都可能存在不相同的带宽极限

如果不设置上下行速度，那么将采用默认的bbr算法，hysteria2将会丧失一大特点

如果设置不合理的带宽速度，由于hysteria2的特性会导致较大的性能损耗，建议将上下行速度精确到每个节点配置。 

官方对此的解释：[brutal的拥塞控制细节](https://v2.hysteria.network/zh/docs/advanced/Full-Server-Config/#_7)

```
Brutal 如果带宽设置低于实际最大值也能正常运行；相当于限速。
重要的是不要将其设置得高于实际最大值
否则会因为补偿机制导致连接速度慢、不稳定，且浪费流量。
```

然后就是希望能支持对单节点配置端口跳跃时间，hysteria2默认时间是10s，这对某些UDP QoS严重的地区会导致经常断连，最好是给用户一个能自己配置的选项。

title: [Bug]: Import: path parameter lost when importing vless URL
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 11 x64 v2rayN v7.15.7

### 预期情况

After importing a VLESS link, the Path field should contain the value from the URL (for example "/testpath").   The imported configuration should keep all parameters exactly as in the original link.After importing a VLESS link, the Path field should contain the value from the URL (for example "/testpath").   The imported configuration should keep all parameters exactly as in the original link.

### 实际情况

After importing the VLESS link, the Path field becomes empty.  
The imported link loses the "path" parameter and only keeps the other ones (like host, type, etc).


### 复现方法

### Steps to reproduce
1. Copy this example VLESS link (test data):
   vless://12345678-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-123456789000@test.server.com:443?security=&type=tcp&path=/testpath&headerType=http&host=example.com&encryption=none#TestNode

2. Import the link in v2rayN (Import from clipboard).

3. Open the imported configuration → the "Path" field is empty.

### Expected behavior
- Path should show "/testpath".
- Host should remain "example.com".
- No parameters should be lost.

### Actual behavior
- Path is empty.
- The imported link becomes:
  vless://12345678-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-123456789000@test.server.com:443?encryption=none&security=none&type=tcp&headerType=http&host=example.com#TestNode
- The `path=/testpath` part is missing.

### Notes
- The issue seems to happen when the `security` parameter is empty (`security=`) in the original link.
- Setting `security=none` explicitly or URL-encoding the path (`%2Ftestpath`) prevents the problem.


### 软件日志

title: [Bug]: Fedora KDE 下自动配置系统代理导致 Firefox DoH 回退明文问题，在全新安装后仍然稳定复现
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Fedora 43 KDE

### 预期情况

DoH策略正常工作, 不回退

### 实际情况

感谢大家先前的调查和回应。为了排除系统环境干扰，我已在相同的实体机上连接一块全新的硬盘，全新安装了Fedora 43 KDE，并确认问题**稳定复现**，这证明问题并非由我个人对系统进行的特殊更改引起。

以下是在全新系统上进行测试的视频：

https://github.com/lingyicute/Files/releases/download/v1/_20251105_003423.webm

**对视频的文字描述（复现步骤与现象）：**

1.  **初始状态（无代理，启用 DoH 且配置错误）：**
    * 在 Firefox 中，我将 DNS over HTTPS (DoH) 服务器地址故意设置为一个**无效的、无法解析的地址**（`https://dns.googla/dns-query`）。
    * 此时系统**未配置任何代理**。
    * 尝试访问 Google 首页，Firefox 正确提示“**无法连接到 dns.googla**”，这是**预期行为**。

2.  **v2rayN 自动设置代理（问题出现）：**
    * 在 v2rayN 中开启并“**自动配置系统代理**”。
    * 再次刷新 Google 首页，却**访问成功**。
    * **结论：** 尽管 DoH 配置错误，但访问网页成功，这**只能证明** Firefox 此时已**回退到明文 DNS** 进行解析。

3.  **手动配置代理（问题消失）：**
    * 使用 v2rayN **清除系统代理设置**。
    * 通过 **KDE 系统设置** 界面，手动应用与 v2rayN **完全相同**的代理地址和端口。
    * 再次刷新 Google 首页，Firefox **恢复预期行为**，提示“**无法连接到 dns.googla**”。

4.  **v2rayN 再次设置代理（问题复现）：**
    * 最后，我们再次通过 v2rayN 进行“**自动配置系统代理**”，覆盖刚才手动设置的配置。
    * 再次刷新 Google 首页，Firefox 访问成功，证明**再次回退到明文 DNS**。

5. 另外，我注意到即使在今天全新安装的系统环境中，日志中也出现了大家讨论的 DBus 错误。这可能意味着该错误是 Fedora 43 KDE 上的常见现象，或者与 v2rayN 代理配置的交互方式有关，而非我“特殊更改”的证据。

### **结论重申**

所有测试都稳定指向一个结论：**v2rayN 自动设置系统代理的动作本身，导致了 Firefox 在 KDE 环境下禁用或绕过了 DoH 功能。**

考虑到我先前报告的 `kioslaverc` 文件中的 **IP:端口** 与 **IP 端口** 格式差异，强烈恳请您 **深入调查** KDE 对这两种格式的解析机制，以及它们可能对依赖系统代理的应用程序（如 Firefox）产生何种副作用。您可尝试一下将 Linux 代理配置脚本 (`proxy_set_linux_sh`) 中写入 `kioslaverc` 的格式，改为 KDE 系统设置使用的 **空格分隔格式**，以验证是否能解决此问题。需要的话，我可以协助测试。


期待您的进一步排查。

title: [Feature request]: 把全系 google 的地址从白名单中删除, 去走代理
body:
### 相关问题

像 fonts.googleapis.com 这种表面上解禁的部分 google 域名, 实际上直连时经常抽风, 导致 v2rayN 使用 V3-绕过大陆(Whitelist) 路由模式时, 最近在不同电脑、不同浏览器上已经多次碰到被 fonts.googleapis.com 这样的域名挂起来几十秒钟, 然后浏览器访问网站失败, 而换成 V3-全局(Global) 路由模式就秒开网站的情况.

现在油管 4K 视频都秒开了, 却为了节省这么一点儿无足重轻的流量, 被这个貌似可以直连却经常抽风的所谓部分解禁给套路, 反而造成墙外网站莫名打不开的情况, 这怎么看都像 GFW 的陷阱, 建议从 cn 名单里去掉.

在百兆宽带、油管4K秒开的时代, 为了一点儿芝麻大的小利, 抱着侥幸心理, 冒着授人以柄、自献软肋给对方的西瓜大的风险, 实在是不值.

这个问题我在 domain-list-community (https://github.com/v2fly/domain-list-community/issues/2923) 也提过了, 他们在等大家的讨论.

### 描述你希望的解决方案

作为一个专门翻墙的软件, 稳定性应该高于快那么微不足道的一点点的利益, 建议把全系 google 的地址都从白名单中删除, 去走代理.

title: [Feature request]: 希望 v2rayN 支持各协议 URI 规范外的一些额外参数，以支持更完整的协议参数分享
body:
### 相关问题

举个例子，TUIC 协议，使用了 sing-box 内核+自签证书搭建服务端。在 v2rayN 界面中开启“信任不安全”后，导出链接中却缺少 `allowInsecure=true`。即使手动加上，也不被解析。导致使用该TUIC分享链接再次导入到 v2rayN，后没有了“信任不安全”这个设置。通俗点讲，就是自己导出的链接，自己都认不出来使用不了。

### 描述你希望的解决方案

TUIC 分享链接，能处理 `allowInsecure=true`。这个还是小问题，特别是考虑到日后将会添加证书指纹（fingerprint）参数后，订阅和节点分享的问题，要能带上才行。这些涉及的范围才大，像 hysteria , tuic , vmess + ws + tls, vless + ws + tls , anyTLS 等等这些都有可能用到自签或者使用 Cloudflare 家证书的情况。

title: [Bug]: The IP goes direct, although it should go through a proxy.
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 11 23H2

### 预期情况

The IP must go through the proxy, since its IP is specified in the range of the rules list

### 实际情况

I have a RuleSet configured for Discord that contains IP ranges and domains. TCP, UDP, and ports 443, 50000-655535 are specified. Almost all requests go through the proxy except for one request for 443. Why does it go direct when it should go through the proxy? (The IP sometimes changes by 1-2 digits, but stays in the same range.)

### 复现方法

I'm not sure how to reproduce this.
Created a RuleSet, specified lists of domains and IP CIDR, specified the ports above (443, 50000-65535), tcp, udp).
All requests from Discord go to the proxy, one request goes to direct.

title: [Bug]: routing rule outbound: core 'xray' does not support protocol 'hysteria2'
body: ### 操作系统和版本 windows 10 ltsc 2021 ### 预期情况 应该能正常分流而非报错 ### 实际情况 1. 我主用 hysteria 2 协议, 我的 vps 无法使用 Gemini, 于是我便白嫖了 [爪云](https://us-west-1.run.claw.cloud/) 的 hysteria 2 节点, 然后就是把 Gemini 的流量分流给 `爪云` 上的 hy2 节点. 2. 现在问题是, 如果我把节点切换成任何非 hy2 的节点, v2rayn 就会报错: routing rule outbound: core 'xray' does not support protocol 'hysteria2'. 见如下截图: 3. 我如果把非 hy2 节点的 core 换成 sing-box (默认全为 xray core), 那么节点 delay 值为 -1, 也就是无法使用. 只有把 Gemini 的 hy2 分流关掉, 非 hy2 的节点才能使用. 4. 我 Google 过, 也查找过曾经的 issues, 都没有相关的 solution, 所以只能自己开个 issue 了 ### 复现方法 如上 ### 软件日志 对不起, 不便贴出! ### 内核日志 对不起, 不便贴出! ### 额外信息 _No response_ ### 我确认已更新至最新版本 - [x] 是 ### 我确认已查询历史issues - [x] 是 ### 我确认系统版本是受支持的 - [x] 是

body:
### 操作系统和版本

MacOS15.6.1 ARM V2RayN 7.15.7 & 7.16.2

### 预期情况

请求按照全局规则被代理。

我在使用V2rayN为Docker仓库代理流量时，运行`docker pull`可以在V2RayN日志内看到

2025/11/16 05:03:03.583018 from 127.0.0.1:61286 accepted //registry-1.docker.io:443 [socks -> direct]

Error response from daemon: Get "https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/": net/http: TLS handshake timeout

title: [Feature request]: v2rayN是名副其实的最佳内存条损坏征兆程序!
body:
### 相关问题

希望在项目README里添加”硬件损坏检测器“的邪修用法。我发现v2rayN的邪修用法：内存条发生损坏时，v2rayN是最早闪退的软件。相反当v2rayN开始不断莫名闪退时，用户应当开始检测电脑硬件。

### 描述你希望的解决方案

说一下我内存条损坏历程和特征吧：我的32gb+32gb组合，通过memtest发现位于约第16gb到第21gb处会随机发生01互变现象，最开始是v2rayN毫无征兆的随机闪退，慢慢发展变成酷狗音乐随机闪退，再后来是原神卡白屏加载+闪退，末期chrome和edge的clash等网页报错status_access_violation和STATUS_BREAKPOINT，最后随机蓝屏。这和cpu缩缸有些像，我尝试降频降压不管，跑memtest时发现内存损坏，现已售后更换新内存条，再使用chkdsk修复被连带破坏的文件系统，现在v2rayN和各软件已完全正常。

title: [Bug]: wireguard的错误配置
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 11

### 预期情况

生成的 wireguard 配置中 "allowed_ips" 应该根据 TUN 中是否开启 IPv6 而使用不同的配置

### 实际情况

现在的做法是无论是否关闭还是开启，都写死了["0.0.0/0","::/0"] ，这会导致当主机禁用 IPv6 的时候，sing-box 会启动不起来。

### 复现方法

主要是 V2rayN 生成的 config.json 中，关于 wireguard 部分中，无论设置中TUN设置页的IPv6是否关闭，都会生成如下的配置：

```json
  "endpoints": [
    {
      "mtu": 1280,
      "address": [
        "10.14.14.4/32"
      ],
      "private_key": "xxx=",
      "peers": [
        {
          "address": "xxx",
          "port": 51880,
          "public_key": "xxx=",
          "allowed_ips": [
            "0.0.0.0/0",
            "::/0"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "type": "wireguard",
      "tag": "proxy"
    }
```
注意，上面的 "allowed_ips" 部分，正确的做法是如果 TUN 设置中开启了 IPv6 ，填写 ["0.0.0/0","::/0"] ，如果关闭了 IPv6 ，则只填写 ["0.0.0.0/0"] 。现在的做法是无论是否关闭还是开启，都写死了["0.0.0/0","::/0"] ，这会导致当主机禁用 IPv6 的时候，sing-box 会启动不起来。

title: [Feature request]: 请使用新版ubuntu或debian构建
body:
### 相关问题

Debian 13（系统自带 ICU 76）程序启动后立即报错并退出：  Couldn't find a valid ICU package installed on the system.  从错误信息判断，当前构建可能依赖较旧的 ICU 版本（如 72/73/74），而最新的 Debian / Ubuntu 已不再提供这些库，因此导致程序无法启动。

提供与 ICU 76 兼容的构建；  打包为自包含（self-contained）版本并内置 ICU；  提供 AppImage / Flatpak 等打包形式，避免系统级依赖冲突。

title: Linux (Debian 12 + Xfce) 下启动失败 — Could not create glyphTypeface: Font family: $Default
body:
### 操作系统和版本

Debian 12 (Bookworm)，桌面环境: Xfce  

### 预期情况

从终端执行 `./v2rayN` 后，程序没有弹出 GUI 界面，而是崩溃

### 实际情况

**问题**: 从终端执行 `./v2rayN` 后，程序没有弹出 GUI 界面，而是崩溃，终端输出如下：

Unhandled exception. System.InvalidOperationException: Could not create glyphTypeface. Font family: $Default (key: ). Style: Normal. Weight: Normal. Stretch: Normal
at Avalonia.Media.Typeface.get_GlyphTypeface()
at Avalonia.Rendering.Composition.Compositor.get_DiagnosticTextRenderer()
at Avalonia.Rendering.Composition.Compositor.CreateCompositionTarget(Func1 surfaces) at Avalonia.Rendering.Composition.CompositingRenderer..ctor(IRenderRoot root, Compositor compositor, Func1 surfaces)
at Avalonia.Controls.TopLevel..ctor(ITopLevelImpl impl, IAvaloniaDependencyResolver dependencyResolver)
…
at v2rayN.Desktop.Program.Main(String[] args)
Aborted


因此 GUI 界面无法启动 / 显示。

## 期望行为

正常启动后弹出图形界面 (window)，能够显示 UI，而不是因为字体 / glyphTypeface 问题直接崩溃。

## 尝试过的方法（但无效）



### 复现方法

-下载7.16.4 .deb版本的v2rayN，执行“sudo dpkg -i v2rayN-linux.deb”命令，v2rayN自动安装在**/opt/**目录下。
在应用里双击“v2rayN”图标，没有任何反应。在/opt/v2rayN/文件内，打开终端，在终端里执行“./v2rayN”命令后，
输出的内容“Unhandled exception. System.InvalidOperationException: Could not create glyphTypeface. Font family: $Default (key: ). Style: Normal. Weight: Normal. Stretch: Normal ……“
后来通过chatget查询，参考chatget给出的方案：
- 安装 / 重新安装系统字体包 (DejaVu)  
- 安装字体缓存与字体配置 (`fontconfig`, `freetype`)  
- 安装 X11 / GTK / WebKit / 基础渲染库 (libx11‑6, libice6, libsm6 等)  
- 刷新字体缓存 (`fc-cache -fv`)  
- 确认 `/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/` 路径下确实有 `.ttf` 字体文件  

依然无法启动 — 问题仍旧出现。

没有软件日志

也没有内核日志

body:
### 操作系统和版本

Windows 11 24H2 26100.7171

### 预期情况

In previous version I could rename defualt route V4-绕过大陆(Whitelist) without problem

### 实际情况

Hello, hope you're doing well.
First of all, thank you for your amazing software — I truly appreciate your work.

After updating to version 7.16.4, I noticed that the default routing rules were recreated. At first, I assumed this was normal due to possible changes in the default rule set.

I manually deleted the old rules (the ones I had renamed in previous versions) and started renaming the default rule groups and sub-remarks again.

I found a specific issue with the default rule “V4-绕过大陆 (Whitelist)”:

If I only change the internal remark names, everything works fine.

But when I change the main remark name of this rule and save it, the application automatically recreates the original three default rules (in Chinese) again.

It seems the main remark rename does not persist and triggers a regeneration of the default rules.

Could you please check whether this behavior is expected or if it’s a bug?

Thank you for your time and support.

I found a specific issue with the default rule “V4-绕过大陆 (Whitelist)”:
